messages:
maria: posted a compact mock for the trace viewer. main changes: sticky request pill, primary "Copy trace" button, kebab with "Download trace (JSON)" + permalink. leaving screenshots in thread. feedback?
ben: looks good. one nit: label "Copy trace" might be ambiguous for engineers. maybe "Copy trace ID" vs "Copy trace JSON" depending on action.
maria: plan was two actions: a quick clipboard copy of the visible stack (Copy trace) and a download file. trying to keep primary action fastest for support use.
ashok: analytics: we need separate events. propose trace.copy.clipboard and trace.download.json. include props: trace_id, user_tier, model_name.
julia: a11y feedback: primary copy button needs aria-label that clarifies behaviour, e.g. aria-label="Copy visible stack trace to clipboard". also add aria-live polite region for copy confirmation "Trace copied".
kevin: keyboard flow: focus order should be header -> copy -> kebab -> frames -> pagination. allow left/right to move pages and Enter to expand a frame. announce "Frame expanded" when opened.
maria: pagination question: should we show page numbers or infinite scroll? our load perf suggests pages of 10 frames is safe.
ashok: pages of 10 + prev/next + page input is best for keyboard users. ensure aria-current on active page button.
ben: export filename: prefer trace-<traceid>.json rather than timestamp; easier for support to attach. include model and region as metadata inside file.
julia: accessibility nit: when a frame is collapsed we should still expose a short accessible name (e.g., function + line) and a toggle button with aria-expanded. SR should be able to jump straight to that toggle.
a11ybot: a11ybot: checklist update: [x] aria-expanded toggles per frame [x] aria-live for copy confirmation [ ] focus ring contrast needs review [ ] tooltips keyboard accessible
kevin: visual nit: focus ring is currently 1px faint blue. recommend 2px solid with 4px outline offset for visibility. also test in high contrast mode.
maria: copy phrasing: we could have two inline labels: primary button text "Copy trace" plus tooltip "Copies visible frames to clipboard". kebab action label "Download trace (JSON)" and inside download filename: trace-${trace_id}.json.
ben: what about a small "Share" action that opens a permalink modal? can live in kebab. permalink copy should also have aria-live confirmation.
julia: make sure the permalink modal is reachable by keyboard and that closing restores focus to the kebab trigger. add focus trap inside modal.
ashok: perf note: lazy-render hidden frames to keep DOM small. also debounce page input to avoid rapid jumping.
maria: i'll update mock and handoff doc: include copy strings, aria attributes, analytics events, and filename conventions. will post revised PNG and a short keyboard flow screencap in ~2 hours :eyes:.
a11ybot: a11ybot: reminder: include role=document for the trace reader region so SR can jump in, and label with the trace id.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup: will iterate and ping again for final review.
